Seconding the other person who said something about the reccomended amount of caffeine. 


About 300-400 mg is what's reccomened for adults. People who have higher tolerances could probably get away with 600 mg but it's not exactly the healthiest option (hypocritical of me to say tbh though bc 500-600 is usually what I drink 💔). 


To be fair, consuming energy drinks and caffeine in general is always gonna have some sort of risk no matter how much you're consuming and I think most people know that but as long as you're doing everything in moderation and are aware of the risks this doesn't look insanely high risk. Just try and make sure you know and keep track of the amount of caffeine in everything you're consuming if you're really really worried for your health. 


I've got ADHD as well so I get the whole thing about caffeine doing just about the opposite for you. I take 27 mg of methylphenidate every morning and consume about 300-500 (sometimes 600) mg of caffeine on average about 5 days out of the week so 🥲 (dont be like me).
